headline: Summoned Skull
title: Summoned Skull Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Summoned Skull. What is it? It is a Level six DARK Fiend Normal Monster with two thousand five hundred attack. What does it do? It has no effect, but it is always treated as an Archfiend card. How do you use it? Level six means one Tribute to Normal Summon it, so it is a big attacker that is easier to bring out than Level seven monsters. It is in Starter Deck: Yugi Evolution.
